_source.title: National Household Travel Survey, July 2025 to June 2026: Press Note and Factsheet
_source.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, Government of India
_source.note: Figures transcribed from the press note of 5 October 2026 (8 pages): its text, Figures 1, 2 and 5, and Appendix Tables 1 to 5. All-India estimates only; the note publishes no state table.

definitions: A trip counts as travel only if it covers 1 km or more. Shorter trips were not recorded.
The primary mode of a trip is the mode used for the longest distance.
A travel day runs from 3:00 AM of one calendar day to 2:59 AM of the next.
A within-travel-day trip ends during a travel day and keeps the person away from home for no more than 24 hours.
An overnight trip keeps a person away from home for more than 24 hours, counting travel and stay, and covers 50 km or more.
